headline: Binding.ts: Critical for Element Binding Logic
what_breaks: packages/element/src/index.ts — relies on exports from binding.ts
packages/element/src/collision.ts — depends on binding logic for element interactions
why: This file contains essential functions and types that manage the binding of elements, which is crucial for the overall functionality of the drawing application. Changes here could directly affect how elements interact and bind to each other, impacting many dependent files.
checklist: Review changes to getBindingGap and maxBindingDistance_simple functions
Ensure any modifications to BindingStrategy type are reflected in dependent files
Check for impacts on element binding in linearElementEditor and collision handling
